## Candidate round-trip / sizing legend

- E_hdr: seed 36-byte canonical header folded (constants/default limits to a flag byte + varints).
- A_delta: index leaf/internal numeric columns + seed numeric param words, delta/varint coded.
- B_dict: provenance strings via a shared dictionary.
- D_intern: every 32-byte content-id reference -> dense varint ordinal; ids recomputed from decoded node bytes (BLAKE3, content-addressing).
- `rt` = the combined blob decoded back to byte-identical seed+index+manifest files for that document.
